args.title: Summary: Bellwether retail returns articles (2026)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
